item.title: How Aprilia is using a banned McLaren F1 trick in MotoGP
item.description: Aprilia will become the first manufacturer in MotoGP to introduce a form of active aerodynamics, with a system similar to one first used in F1 in 2010

item.title: What we've learned about Honda's 'abnormal' F1 engine problem

item.title: Cadillac names its first F1 car after Andretti
item.description: Cadillac's first F1 chassis will be called the MAC-26, as a tribute to its ambassador, Mario Andretti
